comment: Gate 24 (perf-budget). Set 2026-11-25, before the gate first ran, from `dora-bio bench` on a 4-core cloud container.
budgets: about 2.5x the medians measured after brick 23 (denoise 0.271 / 0.298 s, training steps 0.12-0.14 s), so a
slower CI runner still passes but a catastrophic regression fails anywhere.
speedups: the blocked kernels against the reference kernels, timed in the same run, so the check doesn't depend on
the machine. Measured 2.11x (denoise) and 1.54x (Noise2Void step); the minimums leave room for run-to-run noise but
fail if brick 23's gain is lost.
wide_speedups_comment: Brick 36 (S2): the 512-bit kernels against the same blocked kernels limited to 256 bits, interleaved in one run, only
on AVX-512 machines. Measured on the 4-core cloud container over three runs: dilated denoise 1.38-1.64x, Noise2Void
step 1.44-1.62x, U-Net denoise 1.30-1.53x. The minimums sit below that spread but fail if the 512-bit path is lost.
